# chloro

> A Rust code formatter that reproduces rustfmt's output, byte for byte, without the compiler

chloro is a Rust code formatter that writes the same bytes as rustfmt (1.9.0 by default,
or 1.8.0), several times faster and without the Rust compiler. It is a command-line tool
(`chloro`) and two library crates (`chloro`, `chloro-core`; API on docs.rs). Each link
below is the Markdown version of a page of https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/.

## Start here

- [Home](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/index.md>): A fast Rust code formatter that matches the output of rustfmt, byte for byte.
- [Installation](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/getting-started/installation/index.md>): Install chloro's command-line tool from a pre-built binary or from source, or add the chloro and chloro-core crates as a library.
- [Quickstart](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/getting-started/quickstart/index.md>): Check and format a Rust crate with chloro, and run the check in CI, with the same result as rustfmt at edition 2024.

## Guide

- [Command line](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/guide/cli/index.md>): How the chloro command works: sources, check and write modes, exit codes, options, threads and caches.
- [Configuration](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/guide/configuration/index.md>): rustfmt's stable options in chloro, with the same names, values and defaults, and the rustfmt_version option.
- [Parallelism](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/guide/parallelism/index.md>): How chloro spreads files and the items of large files across cores, with identical output at any thread count.
- [Caching](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/guide/caching/index.md>): chloro's caches: skipping files already seen formatted, the opt-in cache of formatted items, and where they live.
- [Library](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/guide/library/index.md>): Formatting Rust source text from Rust with chloro's library functions, in parallel or with a cache of items.

## Reference

- [Command-line reference](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/reference/cli/index.md>): Reference for the chloro command: usage, every option, environment variables and exit statuses.
- [Rust API](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/reference/api/index.md>): chloro's public Rust API on docs.rs, and where each entry point is explained on this site.
- [rustfmt compatibility](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/compatibility/index.md>): What chloro's output has been compared against, rustfmt 1.9.0 and 1.8.0, the options covered, and the known differences.
- [Performance](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/performance/index.md>): chloro's speed and memory against rustfmt and cargo fmt, the conditions of each measurement, and what was not measured.
- [Changelog](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/changelog/index.md>): What changed in each chloro release, for people who use it.

## How it works

- [How it works](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/architecture/overview/index.md>): How chloro turns Rust source into rustfmt's output: lexer, flat syntax tree, and a module-by-module port of rustfmt.
- [Parsing and the syntax tree](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/architecture/parsing/index.md>): How chloro parses with rust-analyzer's parser into a flat array, so that reading the syntax tree allocates nothing.
- [The formatting engine](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/architecture/formatting/index.md>): chloro's port of rustfmt 1.9.0's formatting modules, the layer that adapts rust-analyzer's tree, and its optimisations.
- [Parallelism and caches](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/architecture/concurrency/index.md>): Why rustfmt's top-level items can be formatted independently, and how chloro uses that for threads and caches.

## Optional

- [Development](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/maintainers/development/index.md>): The repository's layout, how to build and test chloro, the conformance checks, and the checks a change must pass.
- [Upgrading the parser](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/maintainers/parser-upgrades/index.md>): How to check chloro's lexer and tree builder against a new ra_ap_parser release before upgrading.
- [Benchmarking](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/maintainers/benchmarking/index.md>): How chloro is measured: instruction counts with callgrind, wall time against rustfmt, and the just vs-rustfmt recipe.
- [Releasing](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/maintainers/releasing/index.md>): How chloro and chloro-core are released with release-plz, the checklist before a release, and the release binaries.
- [Documentation](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/maintainers/documentation/index.md>): Where chloro's documentation lives, and how this website is built, checked and published to GitHub Pages.
- [Project history](<https://lmmx.github.io/chloro/pr-preview/pr-110/history/index.md>): chloro's development journal: how the dated records are organised, the codes they use, and where to start reading.
